purpose: Bounded cold longitudinal fracture benchmark and read-only equilibrium recovery of V11F. No new tower, heat, aircraft or global resistance credit.

bar.eligible_band: Single central cell, width L/n; other cells strictly elastic. Odd meshes keep the selected crack plane at L/2. Numerical band width changes, physical bar and chosen single crack position do not.
bar.material: E,ft,fc,Gf taken from V11E concrete configuration, with original ksi/MPa retained in the input ledger. Uncalibrated hypotheses; no reinforcement, rate or heat.
bar.control: Postpeak opening w=h*(eps-sigma/E), not prescribed end displacement. Solve scalar material compatibility with safeguarded Newton from last committed history, then enforce exact series-bar static equilibrium. This follows an equilibrium path, not free dynamic stability.
bar.closed_form_comparator: wc=2Gf/ft; sigma=ft*(1-w/wc) on monotonic envelope, secant unloading in w. Delta=L*sigma/E+w, P=A*sigma, D_final=A*Gf. Lcrit=E*wc/ft separates ordinary end-displacement softening and snapback for this idealized bar.
bar.negative_control: Force a homogeneous strain branch in every cell, with one or two identical Gauss points per cell and Lch=cell_length/gauss_count. Full energy must be (cells*gauss_count)*A*Gf; reject this as a one-crack interpretation. This is deliberately constrained uniform damage, not a prediction of spontaneous crack multiplicity.

panel_recovery.external_loads: Slab sees -force from each contact, tensile tie and horizontal tie, plus horizontal-tie couple -e*force, uniform gravity and slab-only actuator reaction. Truss actuator is NOT applied directly to the slab.
panel_recovery.equilibrated_fields: N(x)=-sum(Fx_left); M(x)=sum(Fy_left*(x-xi))-sum(C_left)+q*x*x/2. Signed small-strain reference coordinates; jumps at concentrated forces/couples are preserved.
panel_recovery.comparison: Evaluate equilibrated fields at the saved Gauss coordinates, compare to constitutive N/M there; independently reconstruct weak nodal equilibrium with the saved resultants and consistent gravity vector. Do not replace the solved stresses, damage or energy with recovered fields.
panel_recovery.pointwise_gate: Report separately: maximum Gauss discrepancy divided by maximum absolute equilibrated field (floor 1 N or 1 Nm), both N and M <= 5 percent at subdivision 8. Not a stress bound between samples, proof of physical accuracy, or requirement of exact strong equilibrium at finite mesh.
panel_recovery.failed_pointwise_gate_policy: Publish honest diagnostics with implementation PASS if audits pass; do not present failed cases as locally converged. No posthoc widening of tolerances.

method_references.scope: Area under tensile stress-strain curve Gf/crack bandwidth. Own V11E law and own bar derivation, not DIANA execution or calibration.
Displacement interpolation gives weak rather than exact pointwise section equilibrium. Own recovery, not OpenSees execution.
